title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the apparent weight of the man.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the man's rate of expenditure of energy.

title: Correct Use of g
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly incorporate the acceleration due to gravity, g, in their calculations.

title: Understanding of Forces
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate an understanding of how forces interact in the context of the elevator's acceleration.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors when calculating apparent weight and power output.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not omit any necessary factors, such as the contribution of the elevator's acceleration to the apparent weight.
